tools.name: tillhub_get_account
tools.description: The Tillhub user behind the API key: role, scopes, account id and name (no credentials). GET /api/v0/me.

tools.name: tillhub_list_products
tools.description: List products (articles, variants, vouchers) with name, number, barcode, prices, taxes and product group. Filter by type, group, tag, barcode or custom id (barcode and custom_id are fast exact lookups and ignore the other filters). Page with next_query. GET /api/v1/products/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_search_products
tools.description: Fuzzy search products by name and description (max 20 hits per page, with relevance score). GET /api/v2/products/{account}/search.

tools.name: tillhub_get_product
tools.description: One product by id, optionally with the stock and prices of one branch. GET /api/v1/products/{account}/{id}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_product_groups
tools.description: List product groups (categories) with id and name. GET /api/v0/product_groups/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_tags
tools.description: List product tags. GET /api/v1/tags/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_transactions
tools.description: List sales and other register transactions (type, date, branch, register, staff, customer, amounts, payments, cart items). Always pass a date range for busy shops. Page with next_query. GET /api/v1/transactions/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_get_transaction
tools.description: One transaction by id with its full cart, payments and taxes. GET /api/v1/transactions/{account}/{id}.

tools.name: tillhub_transactions_report
tools.description: Detailed transactions report for a period, filterable by branch, register, staff, customer, type and currency. GET /api/v3/analytics/{account}/reports/transactions/overview.

tools.name: tillhub_list_receipts
tools.description: List receipts (printed or digital) of the account. Page with next_query. GET /api/v1/receipts/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_revenue_sum
tools.description: Total revenue between two points in time, optionally for one branch number. GET /api/v0/analytics/{account}/aggregates/revenues/sum.

tools.name: tillhub_sales_aggregate
tools.description: Sales and revenue aggregated per hour or per day between two points in time. GET /api/v0/analytics/{account}/aggregates/sales.

tools.name: tillhub_top_products
tools.description: Best-selling products in a period, optionally for one branch number. GET /api/v0/analytics/{account}/reports/products/top.

tools.name: tillhub_list_balances
tools.description: List cash-register closings (balances / Z-reports) with totals per register and day. Filter by branch, register or staff. Page with next_query. GET /api/v0/analytics/{account}/reports/balances.

tools.name: tillhub_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with name, company, email, phone numbers and addresses. Filter by text, name, email, company or customer number. Page with next_query. GET /api/v1/customers/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_search_customers
tools.description: Fuzzy search customers by name, email and description (max 100 hits, with relevance score). GET /api/v2/customers/{account}/search.

tools.name: tillhub_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id. GET /api/v1/customers/{account}/{id}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_branches
tools.description: List branches (shops) with number, name and address. Use the ids to filter transactions, stock and prices. Page with next_query. GET /api/v1/branches/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_registers
tools.description: List cash registers with number, name and branch. GET /api/v1/registers/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_staff
tools.description: List staff members (cashiers) with name, number and branch. PINs and passwords are never returned. GET /api/v1/staff/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_payment_options
tools.description: List payment options (cash, card, voucher, ...) configured for the account. GET /api/v0/payment_options/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_taxes
tools.description: List tax (VAT) references with rates. GET /api/v0/taxes/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_discounts
tools.description: List configured discounts. GET /api/v0/discounts/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_stock
tools.description: Current stock per product and location. Filter by location (branch/warehouse id) or product id. GET /api/v0/stock/{account}.

tools.name: tillhub_list_stock_locations
tools.description: List stock locations (branches and warehouses) with their ids. GET /api/v0/stock/{account}/locations.

tools.name: tillhub_list_stock_book
tools.description: Stock book: every stock movement (sale, delivery, correction, transfer) with product, location, quantity and date. Filter by product, location, period or text. Page with next_query. GET /api/v1/stock/{account}/book.

tools.name: tillhub_list_orders
tools.description: List incoming or outgoing orders (goods orders between locations/suppliers). Page with next_query. GET /api/v0/orders/{account}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "tillhub_get_account" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: The Tillhub user behind the API key: role, scopes, account id and name (no credentials). GET /api/v0/me.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "tillhub_list_staff" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List staff members (cashiers) with name, number and branch. PINs and passwords are never returned. GET /api/v1/staff/{account}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tillhub_list_customers, tillhub_search_customers · Private data: tillhub_get_account, tillhub_list_staff · Public sink: tillhub_list_customers, tillhub_search_customers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tillhub_list_customers, tillhub_search_customers · Private data: tillhub_get_account, tillhub_list_staff · Public sink: tillhub_list_customers, tillhub_search_customers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
